text:
mike: heads-up: deploybot spotted error-rate drift in eu-dedicated routing after the v3.2.0 config push. errors ~2.8% (baseline 0.2%). deploybot suggests partial rollback to v3.1.4 on eu-dedicated.

deploybot: Auto-action: recommend partial rollback of dedicated pool eu-dedicated -> target v3.1.4 for 50% of traffic. Confidence: 0.82. Awaiting operator ack. Key signals: 5xx 1x, model-timeout 15% on p50.

anya: oncall. +1 to partial rollback to limit blast radius. can we do a staggered shift (50% -> 100%) and pin?

mike: yes. prefer staged approach and hold release notes update until we confirm root cause. Also want legal looped for customer-facing language if theres SLA exposure. tagging @legal.

legal: on it. If SLAs affected we need to avoid technical jargon. Draft blurb suggestion: "We're routing a portion of traffic to a prior model version as a precaution while we address an issue causing increased error rates for a subset of requests in the EU region."

mike: command for staged shift:
```
redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --pool eu-dedicated --from v3.2.0 --to v3.1.4 --pct-start 50 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 5m --reason "error-rate regression"
```

deploybot: Action queued: traffic split job job_id=jb-55190. Operator confirmation required.

anya: confirming and kicking job. I'm monitoring dashboards and traces.

deploybot: Job jb-55190 started. Step1: 50% -> target v3.1.4. ETA per step ~30s.

anya: step1 complete. 50% shifted. errors dropped from 2.8% -> 1.1%. p50 latencies stable. continuing to step2 in 5m unless objection.

mike: no objections. pin v3.1.4 on eu-dedicated when we reach 100%. Hold auto-rollforward and scheduled canaries.

anya: step2 now, shifting remaining 50%.

deploybot: Step2 complete. 100% traffic on v3.1.4 for eu-dedicated. errors now 0.25%.

mike: pin applied: redwoodctl pin --env prod --pool eu-dedicated --version v3.1.4 --ttl 1h --reason "safety pin after rollback"

anya: pin success. created ticket INF-5489 for RCA and rollback notes. assigning to @mike and @sophi (runtime).

mike: release-notes draft for internal: "Temporarily routed EU dedicated pool to v3.1.4 due to elevated error rates after v3.2.0 config. No data loss; mitigated impact within 10m. Investigating config-change interactions with routing policy and timeout thresholds."

legal: approved internal blurb; customer-facing text ready for review once SRE confirms SLA metrics.

ops-bot: Posting incident stub to #statuspage: "EU routing mitigated, partial rollback executed. Updates to follow."

anya: next steps: 1) collect traces for failed requests 2) revert suspect config flags on staging 3) run canary with v3.2.0 and adjusted timeouts 4) schedule postmortem after RCA.

mike: agreed. temporarily disabled auto-rollforward and autoscale policy changes for eu-dedicated. Will add a note to the release notes: "Hold for 1h".

anya: closing this thread for the rollback execution. Will reopen with RCA findings. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks. great coordination.
